description: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development  & Cultural Affairs - Notice under Registration of Persons Act, that the Regulation published in the Gaz.Ex.No. 2021/28 of 31.05.2017 have been approved by the Parliament w.e.f. 22.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette content announces the approval and effective date of regulations made under the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. It specifically deals with legal/regulatory matters - the implementation of regulations that were made by a minister under existing legislation and subsequently approved by Parliament. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
